page: UpCloud GPU-24xCPU-480GB-2xH100 is a GPU-accelerated server instance designed for highly parallelized computational workloads. It features 24 vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon 8462Y+ processor running at 2.0 GHz on the x86_64 architecture, utilizing a KVM hypervisor. The system is equipped with 480.0 GB of system memory, providing a high allocation of 20.0 GB per core. Acceleration is driven by two NVIDIA Hopper H100 GPUs with a combined 160 GB of VRAM. This instance does not include local storage, meaning all storage must be attached externally.

In benchmark testing, the instance demonstrates strong memory and processing capabilities. Memory bandwidth is notable, reaching 4086.55 GB/sec for cached small-block reads and 290.6 GB/sec for uncached large-block reads. CPU performance is highlighted by a PassMark CPU score of 55980.84 and a multi-core stress-ng score of 52357.03. Single-threaded bzip3 decompression achieves a top-tier result of 15.63 GB/sec, while multi-threaded decompression reaches 355.23 GB/sec. For AI workloads, the hardware delivers top-tier LLM inference speeds on small models, processing prompts at 10457.59 tokens/sec and generating text at 366.07 tokens/sec.

This server offers high qualitative cost efficiency for specialized workloads requiring massive memory capacity and dual-GPU acceleration. The high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 20 GB per core and the inclusion of dual H100 GPUs make it suitable for large-scale machine learning, LLM inference, data science pipelines, and complex database operations, which are supported by a strong PassMark database score of 24760.33.
